title: They admit that the unbelieving lack a necessary help
source_text: LXXVI. Nec minus aperte fatentur omnibus illis qui credere renuunt, aut in peccatis indurantur, auxilium aliquod deesse ex parte Dei prorsus necessarium & praerequisitum, ad hoc ut quis actu fidem concipiat, & veram de peccatis poenitentiam agat.
pass_a_gloss: LXXVI. No less openly do they confess that to all those who refuse to believe, or are hardened in sins, some help is lacking on God's part altogether necessary & prerequisite, for this, that anyone should actually conceive faith, & do true repentance for sins.
pass_b_english: Thesis LXXVI. They admit just as openly that everyone who refuses to believe or is hardened in sin lacks some help on God's part that is entirely necessary, and needed beforehand, if a person is actually to come to faith and truly repent of his sins.

choices.english: as to the substance of the matter
choices.why: Le Blanc's verdict on each pairing: agreement in substance, difference in method and wording.
